info.title: Paer CVR API
info.description:
Shared Danish CVR (Det Centrale Virksomhedsregister) data service. Wraps
Erhvervsstyrelsen's public registry for three downstream consumers:

1. **Signup autocomplete** — type-ahead search on company name or 8-digit
   CVR number for the `/signup` form on app.paer.dk.
2. **KYB deep gather** — full company details, beneficial owners, related
   entities, and parsed annual reports for the operator-side KYB review
   in paer-user-api.
3. **Sales prospecting** — n8n workflows pull structured data + persisted
   annual reports for fit scoring + outreach drafting (interpretation
   layer lives in n8n + Claude, not in this service).

This service is **pure data plumbing**. No AI, no narrative summaries,
no fit scoring. Returns raw structured results from Erhvervsstyrelsen
plus parsed XBRL fields, with Postgres caching + S3 persistence of
annual reports for audit + reliability.

## Auth

`X-API-Key: paer_sk_...` for everything except the search endpoint
(public, rate-limited per IP, since signup autocomplete is anonymous).
Keys come from paer-user-api; this service introspects via HMAC.

get.description:
Registered direct shareholders from EJERREGISTER (5%+ stake threshold).
Distinct from /ubos — legal owners can be holding companies; UBOs cannot.
Used by paer-user-api admin overlay as a cross-check against customer-
declared UBOs (a corporate shareholder typically signals an indirect
ownership chain the operator should walk to identify the real UBO).

get.description:
Returns metadata + parsed XBRL summaries for the most recent N reports.
Each entry has a presigned `download_url` (5-min TTL) — fetching the URL
is what triggers the lazy fetch-and-store from regnskabsregister into S3.

schema.title: Response List Reports V1 Cvr Companies  Cvr  Reports Get

get.description:
Returns a presigned S3 GET URL for the annual report file.

First call: fetches from regnskabsregister + stores in S3 + parses XBRL.
Subsequent calls within the file's lifetime: cache hit, just presign + return.

post.description:
Wipe all cached entries for a CVR. Forces the next read to hit Erhvervsstyrelsen.
Operator-only (Paer-Internal A/B). Used by the 'Refresh CVR data' button.

get.description:
Local-env-only download sink. The presigned-GET URL handed out by
`report_storage.presign_download` in local mode points here. In prod the
URL is a direct S3 presigned URL and this route is unreachable
(well, reachable but useless — files don't live on disk in prod).

CvrLegalOwner.title: CvrLegalOwner
CvrLegalOwner.description:
Registered direct shareholder from EJERREGISTER (per Danish corporate
transparency law, threshold is 5% of share capital or voting rights).

Distinct from a UBO: legal owners can be holding companies (entity_type
"company") whereas UBOs must be natural persons. Operators view the
legal-owner list as a cross-check against the customer-declared UBOs —
a corporate shareholder typically signals an indirect ownership chain
that the operator should walk to identify the natural-person UBO.

CvrSignatory.title: CvrSignatory
CvrSignatory.description:
Director / board member from the registry, sourced from the company's
`Vrvirksomhed.deltagerRelation` entries with LEDELSESORGAN role. Only
natural persons (legal-entity signatories are rare and handled separately).

CvrUbo.title: CvrUbo
CvrUbo.description:
Deprecated. Reelle Ejere (UBOs) are not in the free CVR distribution
tier paer-cvr-api currently has access to — they require an obligated-
entity tier (pursued out-of-band 2026-05-15). The `/ubos` endpoint
returns `[]` until access lands; KYB Step 2 customer types UBOs.
